synopsis.text: The Avengers are amidst a training session, where Justice is finally getting over his star-struck nature, and helps complete the training session. Outside the Avengers are facing race and anti-mutant protests, as they look out the window. Scarlet Witch is attempting to confront Vision, as is Wonder Man, about their pasts together. The two engaging in some physical combat, as they argue over their histories and reveal some jealousy. Vision departs to an unknown location after their confrontation. Lastly, Carnivore is gathered by Stonecutter, Decay, and Conquest for the Examplars.
